scope: ordinary/source only; completed matrix combinations only
method: Each listed PNG was opened with view_image. Completion records selected eligible combinations; they do not substitute for pixel inspection. No live application interaction, screenshot generation, test/build, source or original screenshot modification.

coverage.webviewSampling: At least one corresponding image for every theme/zoom pair; exact selected files below.

findings: All 96 target markers are visible with selected text highlighting. Source mode deliberately shows literal TeX, Mermaid and footnote syntax; no rendered-math/vector correctness claim is made.
Both themes retain readable Chinese source text and status text. Menu/header/status scale together with editor text from 100% through 200%; narrow high-zoom header path uses an ellipsis.
Light and dark 200% narrow root source formula lines extend past the right viewport edge; horizontal scrollbar visible. Tail accessibility needs separate native horizontal-navigation verification.

Other reviewed target blocks show no observed horizontal clipping. At larger zoom or after scrolling, unrelated neighboring content meets/clips at vertical viewport boundaries; full-document visibility is not claimed.
Selection highlight/caret appearance is visible, but screenshots alone do not establish DOM focus ownership, keyboard transfer behavior, save integrity or recoverability.
uncovered: All ordinary/live and windowed/source/live matrix screenshots
Dynamic focus/keyboard navigation and horizontal End/Home tail reachability
All-disabled recovery, editing/history semantics and total native-run verdict
The remaining 88 ordinary/source WebView screenshots were not individually opened; only the eight explicitly listed counterparts were reviewed.
reviewStatus: completed requested ordinary/source pixel subset with explicit horizontal-overflow limitation
